mapper.select: SELECT * FROM video_control WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_control (resource_id, no_drag, no_fast_forward, min_play_speed, max_play_speed, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{resourceId}, #{noDrag}, #{noFastForward}, #{minPlaySpeed}, #{maxPlaySpeed}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE no_drag = VALUES(no_drag), no_fast_forward = VALUES(no_fast_forward), min_play_speed = VALUES(min_play_speed), max_play_speed = VALUES(max_play_speed), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
